subject: GROK-HD-SB-WRITER-batch02 Falcon/DJ Chewy storyboard drafts placed
body:
Batch02 storyboard drafts SB-W05 to W09 (Falcon toward DJ Chewy) are placed at D:\Documents\CFA\docs\notes\downloads\GROK-HD-SB-WRITER-batch02\, 1280x720, with NOTES. These are drafts for foreign-return intake, not accepted art, with no timestamps.

NOTES record the Chewy concept choices (face, fur, hands, scale) and their QA.

Key flags:
- W07 was cropped to remove an invented caption bar.
- W08's face is more juvenile and his scale smaller than W07.
- The W06 station geometry differs from W05/W09.
- W09 looks the same direction as W05 rather than being a true reverse.

Hashes are in the attachments.
